experiment: P5t hash-pinned legacy-source-portable detached shared frozen-forward execution
research_question: After resolving the actual E-drive legacy MLCNN source from the installed package and pinning its hash, can the unchanged P5e/P5s output-equivalent shared-forward cost protocol complete on new identity pools?
single_changed_axis: Legacy frozen-model source path portability only. P5t replaces the stale C-drive source root with a package-derived E-drive root and an explicit hash-pinned source manifest. It keeps P5s supervision, analytic chunks, data audit, candidate, model weights, features, batch, warmups, repetitions and gates unchanged.

legacy_source_contract.prelaunch_requirement: Construct and state_dict-load all five frozen P5e models from the manifest before data generation and again before execution.

historical_baseline_audit.rule: explicit baseline and every locally retained generated train MAT must be readable; overlap and unreadable counts must be zero

development_data.roles: evaluation-only; no training, selection, calibration or threshold adjustment
development_data.identity_rule: zero overlap with explicit baseline and every locally retained generated train identity, including quarantined P5p/P5q/P5r/P5s

execution.benchmark_batch: first complete index-ordered batch, indices 0 through 125
execution.reference: two frozen base forwards plus unchanged dense attachment
execution.candidate: one frozen base forward plus identical unchanged dense attachment

detached_chunk_contract.analytic_chunk_rule: chunks preserve source Dataset position order; each internal feature batch remains 126 positions; completed chunks are SHA-256 validated and are never selectively recomputed
detached_chunk_contract.recovery_rule: unchanged P5s rule; completed units never rerun
detached_chunk_contract.supervisor_rule: unchanged P5s hidden detached supervisor with start, child PID and terminal receipt

checkpoint_contract.selection_prohibition: No completed timing/model unit may be selectively rerun.
checkpoint_contract.self_test: P5t source-path/hash and all-five-checkpoint CPU validation, plus P5s chunk/supervisor protocol tests, must pass before generation.

authorized_environment.fallback_if_windows_driver_rejects_mode_: unchanged P5h process-level guard at launch, after every analytic chunk, around every equivalence/timing call and after execution

stop_rule: Any source-manifest/path/hash/checkpoint-load failure, audit failure, external Python CUDA process, missing terminal receipt, output non-equivalence or latency failure stops P5t; no model/data/threshold/timing change and no P5t identity reuse.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only a fresh two-pool confirmation supports the narrow output-equivalent frozen-execution latency claim.
